Summary: Adds a TTL cache shared by the request handlers and an HTTP handler that serves it.

Issues

1. [high] svc/cache.go Get updates the hits/misses counters after releasing the lock, so concurrent handlers race on them and Stats reads them unsynchronized
   → file_read svc/cache.go — confirm which statements run outside the critical section
2. [medium] svc/cache.go Stats divides by hits+misses, which is zero before the first lookup
3. [low] svc/cache_handler.go ignores the error w.Write returns
